g.text: Your esteemed presence and blessings are wholeheartedly requested.
joyfully request the honour of your presence
at the celebration of their Holy Matrimony
Son of Mr. Nihal Fernando & Mrs. Shirani Fernando
Daughter of Mr. Sunil Perera & Mrs. Malkanthi Perera
Welcome drink & traditional Magul Bera welcome
Signing of marriage register & champagne toast
International buffet lunch with live acoustic music
First dance, cake cutting, traditional Sri Lankan Baila
Please respond by 1st October 2026 to help us finalize arrangements.
We are delighted that you (1 guest) will join us!
